title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.0 (Peaked September 28, 2026 at 01:29 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 340 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The Sun's corona is much hotter than its surface, reaching temperatures of over 1 million °C. 🔥☀️✨

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
